title: Beatrix and the Deadline
author: Emrys Marchetti
blurb: Jonah Yarrow, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
